desc: Semble Capability Package: create `internal/semble/doc.go`, `internal/semble/semble.go`, and `internal/semble/semble_test.go` with activation parsing, executable detection, prewarm/offline validation command planning and execution, process-local validation cache, bounded diagnostic classification, prompt-safe context metadata, shell-quoted command examples, target-root safety checks, and the default `.sembleignore` pattern source of truth. Out of scope: wiring into init, worktree creation, prompt templates, SessionStart, operator documentation, durable state config, installing Semble/Python/models, Semble MCP, and remote Git URL indexing.
